LanguageData.JLG_ModeDesc: Switch the whole connected fence between Barrier (a wall of light nobody can pass or damage; open the gate to let your people through) and Burn (anyone can walk through, hostiles are burned; it switches off while a non-hostile passes).
LanguageData.JLG_InspectBarrier: Barrier mode: closed. Nobody can pass.
LanguageData.JLG_InspectOpen: Barrier mode: the gate is open.
LanguageData.JLG_GateOpenDesc: Switch the whole connected fence off so anyone can pass, and back on. It closes only once nobody is standing in its line.
LanguageData.JLG_InspectBurn: Burn mode: burns hostiles that walk through.
LanguageData.JLG_InspectNoLinks: No link: build another post in line within {0} tiles. Beamwire mirrors can turn the fence, and beam windows let it through walls.
LanguageData.JLG_InspectOff: No power: the fence is down.
LanguageData.JLG_PowerDesc: Set how much power each post of the whole connected fence draws. More power burns harder in Burn mode. Per post: {0}.
LanguageData.JLG_InspectPower: Power: {0} W per post, {1} burn per second in Burn mode.
